name: Klara Ziegler
bio:
Klara Ziegler's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the engineering labs of Graz University of Technology. Armed with a degree in mechanical engineering, she initially joined a small Formula 3 team, quickly demonstrating a knack for problem-solving and strategic thinking. Her ability to optimize car performance through meticulous data analysis caught the eye of ROWE Racing, who brought her on board as a race engineer. 

Over the years, Klara steadily climbed the ranks, showcasing exceptional leadership and a talent for fostering a collaborative team environment. As team principal, she champions a data-driven approach, believing in the power of informed decision-making. She is known for her meticulous preparation and her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure. Her distinctive approach lies in empowering individual team members, fostering a sense of ownership and accountability that drives performance.

Klara is also a strong advocate for gender equality within motorsport. She actively mentors young female engineers and drivers, working to create more opportunities for women to succeed in a traditionally male-dominated field. This commitment, coupled with her technical expertise and leadership skills, makes her a formidable and respected figure in the racing world.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara has a focused and intelligent look with a strong jawline and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas or observations.
Insists on a pre-race team huddle, regardless of the schedule.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
